title: Add a final newline normalization for form payloads
body: When entries are added to a form's entry list through the ["append an entry"](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/form-control-infrastructure.html#append-an-entry) algorithm, their newlines are normalized, but entries can be added to an entry list through other means. This change adds a final newline normalization before serializing the form payload, since "append an entry" cannot be changed because its results are observable through the [`FormData`](https://xhr.spec.whatwg.org/#interface-formdata) object or through the [`formdata`](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/indices.html#event-formdata) event. This change additionally changes the input passed to the [`application/x-www-form-urlencoded`](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#urlencoded-serializing) and [`text/plain`](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/form-control-infrastructure.html#plain-text-form-data) serializers to be a list of name-value pairs, where the values are strings rather than [`File`](https://w3c.github.io/FileAPI/#file-section) objects. This simplifies the serializer algorithms. Closes #6247. Closes whatwg/url#562. - [X] At least two implementers are interested (and none opposed): * WebKit implements this (only observable when passing a `FormData` object as the body of a [`Request`](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#request-class) or [`Response`](https://fetch.spec.whatwg.org/#response-class), since it doesn't support FACEs or the `formdata` event). * [Firefox](https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1686765) * [Chromium](https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/6647#issuecomment-844286886) - [X] [Tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt) are written and can be reviewed and commented upon at: * web-platform-tests/wpt#26740 - [x] [Implementation bugs](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/master/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) are filed: * Chrome: https://bugs.chromium.org/p/chromium/issues/detail?id=1167095 * Firefox: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=1686765 (See [WHATWG Working Mode: Changes](https://whatwg.org/working-mode#changes) for more details.) *** /form-control-infrastructure.html ( diff ) /index.html ( diff )
